fact: The OGP Independent Reporting Mechanism's results report (published 2026-08-04, so dated by publication) says Tunisia's National Open Data Strategy still awaits formal government endorsement.

Government decree no. 2021-3 of 6 January 2021, issued by the Head of Government after deliberation of the Council of Ministers, organises the publication of public data under the open-by-default principle for public bodies; the document states no end or replacement.
system: Décret gouvernemental n° 2021-3 relatif aux données publiques ouvertes

fact: A workshop held on 26 March 2026 with the PAGOF programme presented and discussed the final draft of the National Strategy for the Governance, Opening and Valorisation of Public Data, taken under government decree 2021-3 on open public data; the document does not say the strategy is adopted.
system: National Strategy for the Governance, Opening and Valorisation of Public Data (الاستراتيجية الوطنية لحوكمة وفتح وتثمين البيانات العمومية)

fact: The portal's news lists a 27 March 2026 workshop on the final version of the draft national strategy for data governance, opening and valorisation, which covers opening data; adoption is not stated.
system: Stratégie nationale de gouvernance, d'ouverture et de valorisation des données

fact: The Presidency of the Government's e-administration unit says it built the national public data register in application of government decree 2021-03 and Circular 4 of 2024 on open public data.
system: Decree 2021-03 and Circular 4 of 2024 on open public data

fact: The OGP commitment page states that government decree no. 2021-3 of 6 January 2021 on open public data sets technical specifications for the national open data portal and requires an inventory of priority public data.
system: Decree no. 2021-3 on open public data

fact: The IRM 2021-2023 results text says a new version of the national open data portal, built to the decree's specifications, was launched in early March 2023.

The IRM text says the portal carried datasets from 23 data producers across 6 themes (consulted April 2024), and that the e-government unit reported about 296 datasets identified by over 40 public entities in the inventory system by end 2023.
